user.title: Vehicle Tracker
user.description: Configure your Bluetooth tag to monitor your vehicle.

data_description.device_tracker: 📍 The device_tracker entity for your Bluetooth tag (e.g. device_tracker.smarttag_scooter).
data_description.tag_model: 🏷️ Select the SmartThings Find integration you use. Default works for most setups.
data_description.activation_mode: ⚙️ 'combined' (recommended) — arms on disconnect OR stable position. 'position' — arms when GPS is stable. 'connection' — arms on Bluetooth disconnect. 'manual' — you control via buttons.
data_description.notifier: 🔔 Service to use for alerts (e.g. notify.mobile_app).
data_description.tolerance_radius: 📍 Minimum distance (meters) the vehicle must move before triggering an alert (default: 200).

stationary.title: Stationary Detection
stationary.description: Configure how long the vehicle must remain stationary before the alarm activates.

data_description.stationary_minutes: ⏱️ How many minutes the position must stay stable before the timer expires. Recommended: 10.
data_description.stationary_count: 📊 How many GPS samples confirm the position. Set 0 to bypass (activate when timer expires). Recommended: 3.
